model_output.verdict: Your Title I teaching and Washington K-8 certification come through immediately. The reading growth, grade-level leadership and curriculum work back them up. I’d want to talk with you.
write_up: This is a strong teaching resume! Your work at Lincoln Heights and Whitman shows classroom teaching, grade-level leadership and family engagement, with enough detail to make each one concrete.

The reading line is especially strong: it puts district assessment growth from 0.8 to 1.4 grade levels per year alongside the three-year period. Your experience comes before education, and your Washington certification and English Language Learner endorsement are easy to find.

I’d start by adding what you contributed to the positive behavior support committee. Then consider leading with the reading result and, if you’ve had a part in a school-wide decision, adding that to your team leadership line. Your resume doesn’t look like the thing that would hold you back; the school’s needs and competition for the opening matter too.
